_comment: Test counts measured by running each repository's own suite on a fresh clone of its live remote. The per-entry measured field records the date that suite was run: 2026-11-25 for the full sweep of 46 authored repositories, 2026-11-26 for the repositories created that day (gravion-hacker, pe-import-lens, winapi-sentinel, cookie-audit, gravion-bot, openapi-diff, sri-guard, subdangler, vocals, ai-model-fingerprint, memsafety-lab, osint-footprint-checker and winapi-surface-auditor) and for gravion-pets after its source changed, 2026-11-27 for redteamlabs, for the twelve repositories whose source or tests changed after the earlier sweep, and for the six repositories whose code changed after that pass (gravion-ai, rasgulla-ai, localshare, universal-hacker-kit, llm-redteam-kit and redteamlabs), and 2026-11-22 for xerj-ipv6-rate-limit-fix, which is measured against the upstream xerj-org/xerj corpus-hub tree it contributes to. Every clone is checked out with core.autocrlf=false so the bytes match CI's Linux checkout. The source string records the exact command used. These are the only test counts allowed to be published.
